requirements.text: The system must reduce queuing at the library desk.
Students must be able to book study rooms from their phones.
The study room booking process should be simple and user-friendly.
Students must be able to pick a date, choose a time slot, and indicate how many people will be in the room when booking study rooms.
Students must be able to borrow and return books online.
Students must be able to see what they currently have checked out and when it’s due.
Students must receive notifications or reminders for due dates of borrowed books.
The system must automatically inform students about any fines they have and how much they are.
The system must provide heads-ups for upcoming fines.
The system should be clear and straightforward in its communication regarding fines.
